new_text: Mythical sides use the bone-and-tusk walls, fortress and castle for now. Dragon fire run: every Dragon on the field when the battle starts flies off and comes in low and fast from beyond the enemy's edge, over the enemy's side to the middle of the field, turns and flies back out, then returns a moment later and fights as normal. Over the enemy's side it leaves a streak of fire on the ground that burns for 5 seconds; any enemy on the ground that touches it catches fire and takes 5 damage a second until 5 seconds after the streak goes out (flyers and units up on walls are above it). Griffin swoop: every Griffin on the field when the battle starts swoops at twice its flying speed to the front of the enemy army and lands there; every enemy on the ground near where it lands is knocked back a little and takes 2. Then it screeches: every enemy shooter (archers, lasers, quills, the Mage's lightning, Alamosaurus riders) misses its next 2 shots, and every enemy charge stops: a Rhino or Minotaur charge ends, a Megaraptor loses its sprint, and an Alamosaurus that hasn't charged yet won't. Minotaur charge: every Minotaur (including reserves and ones a Mage makes) runs in 60% faster, kicking up dust, until its first hit, which kills the enemy outright; an Alamosaurus, Palaeoloxodon, Laser Tank or Dragon instead takes a normal hammer blow and is stunned for 4 seconds, even though nothing else can stun the Alamosaurus or the Laser Tank. A War Trumpet or a Griffin's screech ends the charge. Mage: every 2 seconds each Mage has a 20% chance to turn one of its side's Minions on the field (picked at random) into a Minotaur with full health, which charges.
